Ana: Need to finalize webinar title + a rehearsal plan by EOD. Idea: a compact, technical session for engineers + product teams.

Mei: New title suggestion: 'Small-Room Inference Playbook: real knobs for latency & cost'. Short abstract: 'A tactical session for engineers and PMs — live demo, benchmark takeaways, and step-by-step ops playbook for serving LLMs reliably at scale.'

Sam: Speakers: Ana moderates, Marco runtime demo, Mei for benchmarks. Rhea out that week.

Marco: Demo plan: deterministic inputs, show prefix cache hit vs cold, then fallback to a quantized variant. Will record a 90s backup clip.

Lina: Lead routing: add checkbox "Interested in a follow-up demo". If checked, tag lead `webinar:followup` and push to AE rotation. I'll set that up.

Ana: Rehearsals: tech check 30m (audio + streaming), full run 45m (timing + transitions), final dress 20m right before live. Sam book Zoom + backstage slack.

ops-bot: ops-bot: suggested slots posted to organizers channel — tech check 2026-05-06 09:00 UTC; full run 2026-05-08 15:00 UTC.

Mei: Assets list: slides (me), benchmark one-pager (me), demo script + backup (Marco), landing copy (Jake), confirmation email (Jake).

Marco: I'll upload demo assets to GDrive and copy locally. Will include a simple `play_backup.sh` in the runbook.

Ana: Run-of-show (tight):
1) 0-4m intros
2) 4-14m benchmark story
3) 14-30m demo + explainers
4) 30-40m quick customer play & lessons
5) 40-45m Q&A + CTA

Sam: I'll also set up a short poll during the event to capture follow-up interest. Lina, can SDRs triage responses same day?

Lina: Yes — we'll monitor poll + form submissions. We'll use the AE note template and aim to outreach within 48hrs.

Ana: Cool. Action items: Mei finalize abstract + slides; Marco upload demo + backup; Sam book and confirm invites; Lina implement routing + AE template. Confirm by EOD. :thumbsup:

Mei: Confirmed.

Marco: Confirmed, backup clip uploading now.

Sam: Confirmed, Zoom booked.
